notes.title: BLASPHEMOUS X PRELUDE DARK PAIN + LAST 48 HOURS
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Today we’re sharing an exciting update and a crucial milestone:

[h2]BLASPHEMOUS COLLABORATION IN PRELUDE DARK PAIN[/h2]

The Game Kitchen and Quickfire Games have announced today a [b]collaboration between Blasphemous and Prelude Dark Pain[/b]. The dark tactical RPG will receive a [b]free DLC inspired by the 2D successful action franchise[/b], including new playable characters from Cvstodia and more. 

This DLC will be [b]free to all Prelude Dark Pain owners[/b] after the full release of the game. You can support our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/quickfiregames/prelude-dark-pain?ref=awh7o0]Kickstarter campaign[/url] until June 5!

[previewyoutube=UMe-NpGpoCs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]THE CROWDFUNDING CAMPAIGN HAS SURPASSED €100,000[/h2]

During the weekend our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/quickfiregames/prelude-dark-pain?ref=awh7o0]Kickstarter campaign[/url] [b]finally reached €100,000 and the Enhanced Map Mode stretch goal has been greenlit![/b] — the map mode now features expanded interactivity and improved graphics.

Initially, the map’s purpose was purely informational, but we are now increasing its functionality and in-game uses, especially when it comes to farming resources. You’ll be able to preview enemies and, in some cases, avoid battles, track main and side quests, locate farming resources, and enjoy improved access to various menus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44371258/bcf2e99d6ea1a3e38afdc1d2712656e95816957a.jpg[/img]

[h2]WHAT’S NEXT?[/h2]

The team is now pushing for the next two Prelude Dark Pain stretch goals for the last 48 hours of the campaign:

[h3]120K - Demon Hunters[/h3]

“Demon Hunters” is a new storyline that would add 4 new heroes to the roster, with their own story and a mission to defeat the most dangerous enemies that you’ll find in the land of Statera.

[h3]150K - Hardcore Mode [/h3]

Prelude Dark Pain currently features one default difficulty setting, but we’d like to introduce an extra hardcore mode designed for the Tactical RPG veterans!

Thank you from the bottom of our hearts,

The Quickfire Games Team

notes.title: Exclusive PRELUDE DARK PAIN DEMO on July 2025, only for Kickstarter backers!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

First of all, we want to thank you again for your support: Prelude Dark Pain has reached 25,000 wishlists on Steam! We are about to enter in the top 1,000 followed games on the store, so if you haven't done already, please consider wishlisting and following Prelude Dark Pain on Steam. 

But we have more exciting news!

[h2]Backer demo on July 2025[/h2]

After hearing your feedback, [b]we have decided to create a demo for [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/quickfiregames/prelude-dark-pain/]Kickstarter backers[/url][/b] so that you can try a small bite of the game. A few select content creators and games press sites had access to a special demo that is not meant for public release. We're working on an adapted version, but it'll take a bit of time.

We are expecting to send [b]Steam keys for the demo on July 2025 to all backers starting at €15[/b] (Digital PC Game - Steam). Even if you have backed a console edition, the demo will only be available on PC via Steam.

Here's some Prelude Dark Pain footage from the alpha demo:

[previewyoutube=XUYXVP7hHD0;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you for everything,

The Quickfire Games team
